sentences.text: If you dig a pit for a tank of gasoline, you have a gas station tank.
But the steel rusts through, and fuel leaks into the soil.
One gallon can make about a million gallons of groundwater unusable.
So you wrap it in a second wall of fiberglass.
But now a leak between the walls stays hidden.
So you put a sensor in the gap that flashes an alarm light.
But now fuel spills at the fill pipe on every delivery.
So you add a spill bucket around the pipe to catch it.
This is an underground storage tank.
Add a concrete cover and a fuel pump on top.
Congratulations, you have built a gas station tank.
